signature: remixFlacAudio(frames: AsyncIterable<AudioFrameData>, channels: 1 | 2, targetFormat: AudioSampleFormat, options: FlacAudioRemixOptions): AsyncGenerator<AudioFrameData, void, unknown>

options.resources: Required Core ResourceContext; input storage must already be accounted by its producer.
options.signal: Required AbortSignal; waits also observe resources.signal.
options.maxFrameBytes: Required positive safe integer; effective per-frame cap is min(value, resources.budget.maxBufferBytes). Oversized frames are rejected, not split.
options.arithmetic: Optional RemixArithmetic: separate (default) or fused; forwarded to existing remixAudioFrame without alternate arithmetic.

formats: Packed and planar u8, s16, s32, flt, dbl; unchanged sample rate, frame sample count, boundaries and exact PTS.
layouts: Only source/destination mono or stereo. Empty, unknown, unspecified and count-only '1 channels'/'2 channels' source layouts normalize to canonical mono/stereo. Explicit noncanonical or multichannel layouts reject.
lifetime: Output owns its planes. Reservation remains live while yielded and releases upon next(), return(), throw(), error or abort-driven resumed iteration. Consumers must finish reading before advancing, or copy under their own reservation. Producer owns input planes and any decoder-frame release.
memory: Before allocating, reserve actual destination bytes plus converted-source internal bytes and (when final conversion occurs) internal mixed bytes. Scratch releases after synchronous remix; output remains reserved across yield. Validate source and every generated frame against effective cap; no prefetch, queues or whole-stream retention. JS/runtime object overhead is outside ResourceContext payload accounting.
cancellation: Iterator next and return waits detach on abort and observe late rejection. Source return is requested on early close/failure; input producer is responsible for eventual cleanup of an uncooperative outstanding next. Close the iterator in consumer finally; abort cannot forcibly finalize a generator suspended at yield until it resumes/closes.
integration: Import remixFlacAudio directly from './flac-wave-remix.js'. Insert after selected/filtered FLAC AudioFrameData and before PCM encoding. Pass the same ResourceContext and execution signal; consume each output synchronously before requesting the next. Preserve existing atomic output-group commit/abort. Coordinator must wire backend options and any root exports separately.
status: Production helper only; backend/CLI integration, oracle comparisons and complete 22-chapter architecture conformance are not claimed.

coordinatorExtension.matrixSampleFormat: Optional AudioSampleFormat: final encoder matrix normalization independent of intermediate FIR precision; default preserves existing behavior
coordinatorExtension.evidence: 18 pinned scalar Native combined rows; 32 public output comparisons on Node and R2/workerd, 26 explicit gap rejection cases
